Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. We reviewed the DPA appendix and have a condensed list of DPIA-related evidence items we need to close our internal privacy review. High-level ask: we need an extract of processing activity examples (Art. 30), plus an evidence manifest showing where audit logs, KMS wraps, and subprocessor attestations live.

Attached is a spreadsheet with line-item asks (AsterHealth_DPIA_Qs.xlsx). Can you confirm:

We want to avoid a full onsite if possible; a sampled extraction + remote walkthrough would be preferable. Please let us know the tightest timeline you can commit to — ideal is by end of next week.

Best,

Samantha — thanks for the clear list and for prioritizing sampling over onsite. Looping in Irene (privacy ops) and Marissa (account lead) so we can scope internally. Quick answers up front:

- Register extract: yes, we can produce an Art. 30 extract scoped to a tenant identifier and a date range. We can provide a CSV with field-level descriptions and a short schema.
- Onshore sampling: we can produce a sampled export of logs for US-region processing only. Sampling proposal: up to 30k log rows (anonymized identifiers) over a 30-day window; delivery ETA typically 7--10 business days after signed scope.
- Subprocessor matrix: we will share our public subprocessor list plus a redacted matrix with roles and data flow descriptors. Full contact-level attestations will be provided in aggregated form; sensitive supplier contracts remain redacted.

Irene, Marissa — can you review the attached quick proposal (redwood-artifact-manifest.pdf) and the sampling CSV draft (onshore-sampling-proposal.csv)? Samantha, if those look okay we can produce a formal sampling plan and an MSP (mutual scope plan) to sign via DocuSign.

1) Internal validation (privacy ops) — confirm any extra evidence items (Irene)
2) Finalize sampling parameters and redaction approach (Marissa + Ava)
3) DocuSign addendum and produce artifacts

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks Ava — putting some specifics in writing to avoid back-and-forth later. Summary of what Privacy Ops can commit to for AsterHealth:

1) Art. 30 register extract:
- Fields: activity_id, purpose_description, categories_of_data (redacted to category level), legal_basis, controller_contact, processing_start, processing_end, processors_involved
- Format: CSV + human-readable PDF explanation (artifact manifest)
- Sampling constraints: extract will be scoped to the tenant identifier and a date range you specify.

2) Onshore sampling export:
- We will produce a sampled export limited to US-region processing nodes; PII will be pseudonymized (hashed IDs) unless you provide a data subject consent exception request in writing.
- Size & cadence: default sample up to 30k rows across a 30-day window; alternate sampling strata available on request (e.g., by model, by API route).
- Lead time: 8 business days after signed evidence MSP and confirmation of sample parameters.

3) Subprocessor matrix + attestations:
- Public subprocessor list: immediate (link to published page).
- Supplemental matrix: redacted roles + data-flow descriptors within 3 business days.
- Formal attestations covering SOC/KMS wrap: we can provide scope-limited attestations; full contracts redacted.

4) Audit rights / access model:
- Remote review: supported via shared folder + scheduled walkthroughs with privacy ops and engineering.
- Onsite: possible but requires legal sign-off and a scoped audit plan; expect a 4+ week lead time and additional costs.

Please confirm if the pseudonymization approach and 8-business-day lead time are acceptable. If yes, I'll draft the MSP language and coordinate the DocuSign addendum.

Irene Choi
Director, Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Ava / Irene / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear commitments. A couple of clarifications from our side before we proceed with signing the MSP:

- Pseudonymization: hashing is acceptable for the sample. We will provide the tenant ID and target date range (June 1–30) once the MSP draft is ready.

If you can confirm walkthrough format and the 8-business-day delivery after MSP signature, we will route the DocuSign. We aim to have artifacts in hand by July 5 to meet our program timeline.
